name: Business Letter
useWhen: Use this for a formal message on paper or PDF to a company, landlord, school, or office.

sections.label: Your address
sections.what: Your street address, then city, state, and ZIP, each on its own line.
sections.tip: Don't put your name here. It goes in the signature.
sections.good:
24510 Main Street, Apt 3
Santa Clarita, CA 91321

sections.label: Date
sections.what: Today's date, written out in full.
sections.tip: Write the month as a word: October 28, 2026.

sections.label: Their name and address
sections.what: The reader's name and title, company, street, and city, state, ZIP.
sections.tip: One item per line. Use their title if you know it.
sections.good:
Ms. Dana Alvarez
Property Manager
Oak Ridge Apartments
1200 Oak Ridge Road
Valencia, CA 91355

sections.label: Greeting
sections.what: "Dear" plus their title and last name, then a colon or comma.
sections.tip: Use their title and last name if you know it.

sections.label: Purpose
sections.what: Why you're writing, in one or two sentences.
sections.tip: Say why you're writing in one or two sentences.
sections.good: I'm writing to request a copy of my lease by Friday, Nov 6.
sections.bad: I just wanted to reach out about some stuff.

sections.label: Details
sections.what: The facts: dates, numbers, names, and anything the reader needs to act.
sections.tip: Put facts in the order they happened. Start a new paragraph for each new topic.
sections.good: I moved into Unit 4B on March 1, 2025. My bank needs the lease for a car loan due Monday, Nov 9.
sections.bad: There's a lot going on and I need it for reasons.
phrases: For reference, my account number is…

sections.label: Ask
sections.what: The one action you want them to take next, and the date.
sections.tip: Make one clear request with a real date and how to reach you.
sections.good: Please mail or email the copy by Friday, Nov 6. You can reach me at (661) 555-0142.
phrases: I would appreciate a reply by [date].

sections.label: Closing
sections.what: A thank-you line and a formal sign-off word.
sections.tip: Thank them, then "Sincerely," on its own line.
sections.good:
Thank you for your help.

Sincerely,
phrases: I appreciate your help with this.

sections.label: Signature
sections.what: Your typed full name, plus title and contact info if useful. Leave room above it to sign by hand.
sections.tip: Your full name, then your title, phone, or email.

topics.name: General
topics.tone: Formal and clear. Get to the point in the first paragraph.
dos: Use full addresses and the date
Say why you're writing in the first two sentences
Keep it to one page

topics.name: Thank You
dos: Name what they did: the task, the day, the help
Say how it helped
Send it within a week

purpose.tip: Say thank you and name what they did.
purpose.good: Thank you for writing my reference letter for the Valley College nursing program.
phrases: I want to thank you for…

ask.what: An optional next step, like an update or an offer to help back.
ask.tip: You don't have to ask for anything. Offer an update or to return the favor.
ask.good: I'll let you know when I hear back in December.
ask.bad: Also can you do another one
phrases: Please let me know if I can return the favor.

topics.name: Apology
topics.tone: Own it. Skip the excuses. Say how you'll fix it.
dos: Say sorry in the first sentence
Name what went wrong, in plain words
Say what you'll do next

purpose.tip: Say what happened and that you're sorry.
purpose.good: I'm writing to apologize for the late payment of my October rent.
purpose.bad: I guess I should say sorry about the rent thing.

details.what: Walk through the four parts of a real apology.
details.tip: Fill in each box. Keep each one short and honest.

topics.name: Complaint
topics.tone: Firm and calm. Stick to facts and ask for a fair fix.
dos: Give dates, order numbers, and names
Describe what happened, not how angry you are
Ask for a specific fix
donts: Use ALL CAPS or lots of !!!

purpose.tip: Name the problem and the order or account number.
purpose.good: I'm writing about order #48213, which arrived damaged on Oct 26.
phrases: I'm writing about a problem with…

details.what: Describe the problem without blame: Situation, Behavior, Impact.
details.tip: Facts only. Anyone reading it should agree it happened.

ask.tip: Ask for one fair fix: refund, replacement, or repair, with a date.
ask.good: Please send a replacement desk by Friday, Nov 6, or refund my $289.

topics.name: Request
topics.tone: Polite and specific. Make it easy to say yes.
dos: Name what you need: the item, the amount, the date
Give a reason
Give a real deadline
donts: Leave out how to reach you

details.what: Make your case: Point, Reason, Example, Point again.
details.tip: Give the one best reason and a real example.

topics.name: Resignation
topics.tone: Grateful and professional. Leave on good terms.
dos: Give your last day
Thank them for a specific project, lesson, or kindness
Offer to help with the handoff
donts: Complain about the job or people

purpose.tip: Say you're resigning and give your last day.
purpose.good: I'm resigning from my position as Sales Associate. My last day will be Friday, Nov 13.
phrases: Please accept this letter as notice that I'm resigning from…

details.what: A short thank-you and your plan for the handoff.
details.tip: Thank them for one real moment or lesson. Say how you'll wrap up your work.
details.good: Thank you for training me on the register and inventory system. Before I go, I'll finish the November schedule and show Sam the reorder process.
details.bad: This place was okay I guess.

ask.tip: Ask how they'd like to handle the handoff, or confirm next steps.
ask.good: Please let me know if there's anything else you'd like me to finish before Nov 13.
phrases: Please let me know how I can help with the transition.

topics.name: Reference Request
topics.tone: Respectful and easy to say yes to. Give them what they need.
dos: Remind them how they know you
Say what the reference is for and the deadline
Offer your resume or details

purpose.tip: Ask if they'd be willing to be a reference, and for what.
purpose.good: I'm applying for a Medical Assistant job at Henry Mayo Hospital and would be grateful if you'd serve as a reference.
phrases: Would you be willing to serve as a reference for…?
I'm applying for… and would be grateful if…

details.tip: Remind them how they know you and what you did together.
details.good: I worked for you at Valley Clinic from June 2023 to August 2025, where I handled patient check-in.
phrases: I worked with you at… from… to…
